messages:
Mia: Heads-up — vendor just said 4 racks will arrive at our EU-WEST1 colocation next Wed. Need serials and cloud quota check before we hand to on-prem team. Anyone on tracker?
Raj: Which racks? can you drop the vendor packing list?
Mia: They sent a short manifest in the shipment email: `rack-ids: R12,R13,R14,R15` and GPUs: `2xA100-80GB, 4xH100-80GB per rack (mix)`. Tracking: https://vendor.example/track/INB-98123 — ETA 2025-06-18 14:00 CEST.
DevOpsBot: Shipment INB-98123 status: In Transit. Last scanned at FRA hub (2025-06-17 08:12 UTC). ETA to facility: 2025-06-18 13:45 CEST. :truck:
Lina: Quick quota note — we only have 60 A100/H100 GPUs allowed in eu-west1 project account right now. If each rack has ~6 GPUs of those types we might exceed soft quota depending on active pools. I can open a quota increase but need usage justification.
Anders: @Lina I can toggle a few non-prod pools to preemptible/spot for the week of the install to avoid hitting quota if the increase is slow. Which ticket should I link?
Lina: Opened request with cloud support: TICKET-124512 — asking for +32 GPUs (A100/H100) for 48h window starting 2025-06-18. Put the manifest and expected start time in the ticket.
Carlos: On-prem install team schedule — we can do rack intake Tue/Wed 09:00–17:00. Need serial numbers as soon as they hit facility scan so we can map R12..R15 -> inventory tags and run burn-in. Also need power rack PDUs and KVM creds.
Mia: Good call. Can someone confirm vendor will provide the GPU serial numbers in the delivery manifest? Their note was vague.
Raj: Reached out to the vendor contact (Olga). She replied: "we'll provide unit serials at shipment scan — full list attached to final POD." Copy of message: ```Olga: serials will be available at depot scan, we can share CSV before vehicle leaves for customer site```
Lina: If they can share CSV, please ask for columns: `rack_id, slot, gpu_model, serial, fw_version`. That makes inventory import trivial.
Anders: For verification on our side, plan to run: ```inventoryctl import --csv inbound_INB-98123.csv && inventoryctl scan --rack R12 --format csv > R12-scan.csv``` Then map serial -> kvm mapping.
Carlos: Also confirm remediations — if any GPU fails burn-in we'll swap from the spare pool or vendor RMA. Where are the spares located?
Mia: Spares: 8 GPUs in eu-west1 spare cage (A100/H100 mix). I updated the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inventory/inbound-rack.md — says to hold one rack's capacity for failovers.
DevOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: `inbound-rack-intake` reminder set for 2025-06-18 08:00 CEST with @onprem-team.
Lina: One more — quota question for Redwood Dedicated customers: if we bring these racks online in private deployments, do we need separate cloud quotas? This is on-prem gear so no cloud quota impact, but if we plan to attach to our control plane we need to ensure license counts. I'll coordinate with product billing.
Raj: I'll follow up with vendor to get the CSV ASAP. If we get serials by EOD Mon we'll generate the import and send the ticket update.
Carlos: Sounds good. I'll block intake slots Wed 09:00–13:00 for rack R12/R13 and 13:00–17:00 for R14/R15.
Mia: Thanks all — please add short replies if you have blockers. :thumbsup:
Raj: Got it. ping me if vendor delays, I'll escalate.
Anders: I'll prepare the burn-in playbook and tag the oncall for that day.``
